sources.content: The paldrix-runner image runs a Paldrix CI build agent. It is built on debian:12 and runs as user runner with user ID 1001. The agent connects out to the Paldrix server and does not listen on any port for jobs; port 9300 serves only its status endpoint. Workspaces are created under /home/runner/work, and a volume at /home/runner/.cache keeps tool caches between jobs. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/paldrix-agent. The image includes git, curl and a C toolchain.

Environment variables. PALDRIX_URL gives the server address and PALDRIX_TOKEN the registration token; both are required. PALDRIX_LABELS sets runner labels as a comma separated list and defaults to linux,x64. PALDRIX_CONCURRENCY sets parallel jobs and defaults to 1. With PALDRIX_EPHEMERAL=true the agent takes one job and then exits. The health check runs paldrix-agent status every 60 seconds. PALDRIX_JOB_TIMEOUT sets the maximum job length in minutes and defaults to 120. Set PALDRIX_DOCKER=true to mount the host Docker socket for jobs that build images.

claims.text: The paldrix-runner image runs as user ID 1001.
The Paldrix agent listens on port 9300 for jobs.
The paldrix-runner image keeps tool caches in a volume at /home/runner/.cache.
With PALDRIX_EPHEMERAL=true, the Paldrix agent exits after one job.
